 Oral Order

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 64 of 2021,
registered for the offence punishable under Sections 323, 341, 498(A), 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that implication in the instant case is based on falsehood.
The petitioner in fact is the victim, he was abandoned by the informant while at Mumbai.
She left behind her two children, who are being taken care of by the petitioner.
The submission is that the petitioner is desirous of continuing in matrimonial relationship with the informant.

3. Issue notice to opposite party no. 2 through both Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46778 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 modes i.e., under registered cover with A/D as well as under ordinary process, for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week, failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to a Bench.
4.
